description: Define the build artifact contract the pipeline consumes: rewrite container/taskdef.json as the prod CodeDeploy template (family coffee-ship-prod, container 'web', image '<IMAGE1_NAME>'), create container/appspec.yaml (ECS blue/green), and update container/buildspec.yml to emit FOUR artifacts — imagedefinitions.json (rolling test), imageDetails.json (prod CodeDeploy), taskdef.json, appspec.yaml. Resolves HIGH finding 1 (imageDetails.json was missing). No '|| true' gates. Depends on nothing but is a prerequisite for FEAT-003 (the CDK wiring references these artifact shapes and env-var keys). Do NOT touch app/appspec.yaml.
steps: Replace container/taskdef.json entirely: family 'coffee-ship-prod', networkMode awsvpc, requiresCompatibilities ['FARGATE'], cpu '256', memory '512', runtimePlatform X86_64/LINUX, executionRoleArn '<EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN>', taskRoleArn '<TASK_ROLE_ARN>'; single containerDefinitions entry name 'web', image '<IMAGE1_NAME>', essential true, portMappings [{containerPort 8080, protocol tcp}], environment [{ORDERS_QUEUE_URL '<ORDERS_QUEUE_URL>'},{ORDERS_TABLE_NAME 'coffee-ship-orders'}], logConfiguration awslogs group '/ecs/coffee-ship-prod' region 'ap-southeast-1' stream-prefix 'coffee-ship-prod'. Keep '<IMAGE1_NAME>' literal (CodeDeploy fills it); ORDERS_TABLE_NAME stays the hard-coded literal (not substituted).

Create container/appspec.yaml: version 0.0; Resources: - TargetService: Type AWS::ECS::Service, Properties: TaskDefinition <TASK_DEFINITION>, LoadBalancerInfo { ContainerName 'web', ContainerPort 8080 }, PlatformVersion 'LATEST'. (This is the container blue/green appspec; app/appspec.yaml is the separate serverless one and must stay unchanged.)
In container/buildspec.yml keep `python -m py_compile container/app.py` in the build phase and the docker build (:latest + unique IMAGE_TAG). Keep both `docker push` lines with NO '|| true'.

In post_build after the pushes, emit (a) `printf '[{"name":"web","imageUri":"%s"}]' "$REPO_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" > imagedefinitions.json`; (b) `printf '{"ImageURI":"%s"}' "$REPO_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" > imageDetails.json`; (c) a guard `test -n "$PROD_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN" && test -n "$PROD_TASK_ROLE_ARN" && test -n "$ORDERS_QUEUE_URL"`; (d) a multi-line `sed` using '#' delimiters that renders container/taskdef.json into artifact-root taskdef.json substituting <EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN>->$PROD_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN, <TASK_ROLE_ARN>->$PROD_TASK_ROLE_ARN, <ORDERS_QUEUE_URL>->$ORDERS_QUEUE_URL and leaving <IMAGE1_NAME>; (e) `cp container/appspec.yaml appspec.yaml`; (f) `cat imagedefinitions.json imageDetails.json taskdef.json appspec.yaml`.
Set buildspec artifacts.files to exactly: imagedefinitions.json, imageDetails.json, taskdef.json, appspec.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: container/taskdef.json parses as JSON, container name is 'web', family 'coffee-ship-prod', contains exactly one '<IMAGE1_NAME>' and the three substitution tokens.
container/buildspec.yml lists all four artifact files, emits imageDetails.json with shape {ImageURI}, and contains no '|| true'.
verification: grep -n '|| true' container/buildspec.yml || echo 'no || true gates (expected)'
findings: ARTIFACT CONTRACT FEAT-003 MUST MATCH. Buildspec is container/buildspec.yml; it emits FOUR artifacts at the build artifact root (artifacts.files, in this exact order): imagedefinitions.json, imageDetails.json, taskdef.json, appspec.yaml. JSON SHAPES: imagedefinitions.json = JSON array [{"name":"web","imageUri":"<REPO_URI:IMAGE_TAG>"}] (rolling Test EcsDeployAction, container name 'web'); imageDetails.json = JSON object {"ImageURI":"<REPO_URI:IMAGE_TAG>"} (prod CodeDeployEcsDeployAction containerImageInputs, taskDefinitionPlaceholder 'IMAGE1_NAME'). PROD TASKDEF TEMPLATE: container/taskdef.json is the source template (family 'coffee-ship-prod', single containerDefinitions entry name 'web', containerPort 8080/tcp, logs group '/ecs/coffee-ship-prod' region ap-southeast-1 stream-prefix 'coffee-ship-prod'). TOKENS in container/taskdef.json: exactly one each of <EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN>, <TASK_ROLE_ARN>, <ORDERS_QUEUE_URL> (all three substituted by buildspec sed with '#' delimiter) and exactly one <IMAGE1_NAME> (left literal; CodeDeploy fills it). ORDERS_TABLE_NAME is the hard-coded literal 'coffee-ship-orders' (not substituted). ENV-VAR KEYS the CodeBuild project must set for the sed guard+render to pass: PROD_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN -> <EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN>, PROD_TASK_ROLE_ARN -> <TASK_ROLE_ARN>, ORDERS_QUEUE_URL -> <ORDERS_QUEUE_URL>; buildspec guards all three with `test -n` before rendering (fails build if any empty). APPSPEC: container/appspec.yaml (version 0.0; Resources TargetService Type AWS::ECS::Service, Properties TaskDefinition <TASK_DEFINITION>, LoadBalancerInfo ContainerName 'web'/ContainerPort 8080, PlatformVersion 'LATEST') is copied verbatim to artifact-root appspec.yaml for the prod CodeDeploy ECS blue/green action. NO '|| true' gates anywhere (sole 'true' match is inside an explanatory comment). app/appspec.yaml (serverless path) left byte-for-byte unchanged. All FEAT-002 verification commands pass; sed dry-run yields valid JSON with <IMAGE1_NAME> preserved.
